description: Find the right KBLI 2025 business classification code (5-digit, mandatory in Indonesia's OSS business licensing since 15 June 2026) from a free-text business activity in Indonesian or English. Returns official BPS titles, descriptions and hierarchy. Costs $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base; see lokalapi_info).

q.description: Business activity, e.g. 'kafe', 'software development', 'nickel mining', or a KBLI code
